principle: Not every tool component is self-built — some are EXTERNAL APIs (RapidAPI / Apify marketplaces), often MORE deterministic + reliable than driving a browser (e.g. a hosted FB-page scraper vs fighting FB anti-bot). These are first-class rungs the descent can select, behind the credential plane's key-ownership model (byo OR platform-within-limits). GOVERNED: scraping/enrichment entries honor source ToS, use PUBLIC metadata only, store NO PII, and are cataloged-not-auto-enabled. discovery≠trust; serves_truth=false. The marketplace key resolves via architecture/credential_registry.json (rapidapi/apify).
governance: ToS-sensitive entries (social_scrape, web_unlocker) are CATALOGED so the descent KNOWS the option exists, but are gated by research_guardrail_policy + an explicit enable + public-metadata-only + no-PII. Cataloged != used.

apis.name: Facebook page (public) scraper
apis.governance: ToS_sensitive: public page metadata only, no PII, honor Meta ToS; enable explicitly

apis.governance: ToS_sensitive: public firmographic only, no scraping of people PII; BYO key
